raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The image displays a pie chart illustrating the distribution of project implementers' preparedness levels for executing projects according to the Passive Construction Standard. The chart is divided into four segments, each representing a different category of readiness. The largest segment, colored green, accounts for 51% of the total and corresponds to the category "A very small number of implementers/project managers are prepared to execute projects according to the Passive Construction Standard, and a large number of specialists need training for the implementation of the standard." The second largest segment, colored purple, represents 23% and is labeled "Prepared and well-qualified are those who can execute projects according to the Passive Construction Standard." A red segment, also representing 23%, corresponds to "Only a part of the implementers/project managers are prepared to execute projects according to the Passive Construction Standard." The smallest segment, colored blue, accounts for 3% and is labeled "There are sufficiently prepared and qualified specialists for the implementation of the standard according to the Passive Construction Standard." The chart includes a legend on the right side, with each category's label and corresponding color. The percentages for each segment are explicitly displayed within the pie chart itself. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, starting with the green segment at the bottom, followed by the red, purple, and blue segments.
